percent.description: With destroy-percent: share of the planes or supplies destroyed, raider's choice of which

points.description: With truck-points-lost: raided player picks the truck type, raider the cargo (replacement points only if unavoidable)

reroll_if_infantry_replacements.description: If any truck carries infantry replacement points, roll one die again; this range eliminates the raider

cp_cost.description: CP the raider spends per raid

combined_airfield_and_planes_cp.description: CP for one raid on an airfield and the planes on it together; resolved separately, airfield first

die.description: One die; ranges cover 1–6 in order

not_if_combat_units.description: May not be raided while enemy combat units are in the hex

combinable_with.description: May be combined with this target in one raid at combined_airfield_and_planes_cp

lrdg_only.description: Only Commonwealth Long Range Desert Groups

survive_if_sum_at_least.description: Total raw (unparenthesised) close-assault defence points of the combat units in the hex

guard_check.description: Rolled first; on surviving, resolve as the row named in 'then'

reveal_dump_type_after.description: After a completed raid the owner says whether the dump is real, a non-dump or a dummy

all_infantry_replacements.description: If every truck in the convoy carries infantry replacement points: raider eliminated, no roll, trucks untouched
